description: This file defines a Orleans grain class named DefaultDirectoryGrain implementing the IDefaultDirectoryGrain interface. It includes methods for pinging, resetting a counter, retrieving the runtime identity, and proxying a ping to another grain.

classes.name: DefaultDirectoryGrain
classes.description: A Grain class that provides directory-related functionalities, including counter management and identity retrieval.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Increments an internal counter and returns its new value asynchronously.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the internal counter to zero asynchronously.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Returns the runtime identity of the grain asynchronously.

methods.name: ProxyPing
methods.description: Proxies a ping request to another grain implementing ICommonDirectoryGrain.
